title: Fourth quarter and Full year 2016 summary report

evidence.locator: pp. 2-3, Basis of preparation and calendar footnotes
evidence.facts: IFRS consolidates former Delhaize from July 24, 2016. Pro forma treats the merger as occurring at the start of the 2015 financial year and includes remedy-store and other divestment adjustments. It is hypothetical comparative information, not actual historical combined results. Former Ahold FY/Q4: 2016 52/12 weeks, 2015 53/13. Former Delhaize FY/Q4: 52/13 in both years. The pro forma calendars remain different across the former groups. The 2016 Q4 calendar adjustment reinstates October 1-9 for European Delhaize and the corresponding October 2-9 U.S. period excluded from the IFRS presentation. CSE includes former Ahold Czech operations and former Delhaize Greece, Romania and Serbia.
